title: Phone width: an embedded grid's primary record link is a 22 px tap target
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29074 (seat 4's phone run for #29071, PR #29210, report comment 6573777431) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** On a phone, the record link in an embedded grid (a related list's rows on a record page) is the only way to open the row, and it is 22 px tall. That is half the 44 px floor the Console phone audits (#29040) apply, so a thumb often misses it or hits the row next to it.

**Measured (seat 4, live at 375 px on the showcase, PR #29210 run; and the #29074 dev by reading `origin/main` after `ea150b7f`).**
- The link cell's class is `LINK_CELL_CLASS` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` (L18-19). It gives the link no minimum height, so it measures 22 px.

**Why it is its own card.** The direct fix (`max-sm:min-h-11 max-sm:flex max-sm:items-center` on the link) makes every phone table row at least 44 px. That visibly changes every embedded grid at phone width. Desktop is unchanged. Whoever takes it should decide whether the row grows or only the hit area does (for example a padded pseudo-element), and measure both related lists and full grids at 375 px.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` and a token or geometry test.
